attrs.label: Postgres Image (CAUTION)
attrs.description:
If you are changing this after the postgres directory has been initialized,</br>
STOP! and make sure you have a backup of your data.</br>
Changing this will trigger an one way database upgrade.</br>
You can only select newer versions of postgres.</br>
Selecting an older version will refuse to start.</br>
If something goes wrong, you will have to restore from backup.

attrs.label: Base URL
attrs.description:
The URL used to access Inbox Zero, including the port.</br>
It must match the redirect URIs configured in your OAuth providers.</br>
Example: http://truenas.local:30529

attrs.label: Auth Secret
attrs.description:
Secret used to sign user sessions.</br>
Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

attrs.label: Email Encryption Secret
attrs.description:
Secret used to encrypt the stored email provider tokens.</br>
Changing it after setup makes the stored tokens unreadable.</br>
Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

attrs.label: Email Encryption Salt
attrs.description:
Salt used to encrypt the stored email provider tokens.</br>
Changing it after setup makes the stored tokens unreadable.</br>
Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 16

attrs.label: Google (Gmail)
attrs.description:
Users sign in and connect their mailboxes with Google or Microsoft.</br>
At least one of them must be enabled.

attrs.label: Pub/Sub Topic Name
attrs.description:
Optional. The Google Cloud Pub/Sub topic used for real-time Gmail notifications.</br>
Example: projects/my-project/topics/inbox-zero

attrs.label: Default LLM Provider
attrs.description:
The default AI provider, e.g. anthropic, openai or ollama. See LLM setup for every provider and the variables it needs (API key, model, URL), set them in Additional Environment Variables.
Users can also enter their own provider and API key in Inbox Zero's Settings.

attrs.label: Additional Environment Variables
attrs.description: Applied to both the Inbox Zero and worker containers.

attrs.label: User ID
attrs.description: The user id that Inbox Zero files will be owned by.

attrs.label: Group ID
attrs.description: The group id that Inbox Zero files will be owned by.

attrs.label: Port Bind Mode
attrs.description:
The port bind mode.</br>
- Publish: The port will be published on the host for external access.</br>
- Expose: The port will be exposed for inter-container communication.</br>
- None: The port will not be exposed or published.</br>
Note: If the Dockerfile defines an EXPOSE directive,
the port will still be exposed for inter-container communication regardless of this setting.

enum.description: Publish port on the host for external access
